get.description: Returns aircraft family information (family and manufacturer) for a specific family (HU32)

Sets the airline route status to inactive. Idempotent operation.

Sends an email with instructions to reset the password. Always returns success for security.
Refreshes the access token using a valid refresh token
Resends the verification email to a registered user who hasn't verified their account
Allows updating the password using a token received by email. Token expires in 12 hours.

get.description: Returns the profile information of the authenticated employee

put.description: Updates the basic information of the authenticated employee. Preserves: email, password, airline, bp.

get.description: Returns the airline information (airline_id, airline_name, bp) of the authenticated employee

404.description: Employee not found or no airline assigned

put.description: Adds airline information (airline_id, bp, start_date, end_date) for the authenticated employee. New employees are set as active=true by default. The 'active' field is not accepted - use activate/deactivate endpoints for that.
put.summary: Add airline information for authenticated employee

parameters.description: Airline information to add (airline_id, bp, start_date, end_date)
parameters.name: airline

400.description: Invalid request data or date format

put.description: Updates the airline information (airline_id, bp, start_date, end_date) for the authenticated employee who already has airline info. The 'active' field is not editable - use activate/deactivate endpoints. Requires existing airline info.
put.summary: Edit airline information for authenticated employee

parameters.description: Airline information to update (airline_id, bp, start_date, end_date)
parameters.name: airline

400.description: Invalid request data or date format

404.description: Employee has no airline info to update

get.summary: List routes for authenticated user's airline

patch.summary: Activate airline information for authenticated employee

404.description: Employee has no airline info to activate

patch.description: Deactivates the airline information for the authenticated employee. The employee must already have airline info assigned.
patch.summary: Deactivate airline information for authenticated employee

404.description: Employee has no airline info to deactivate
